rationale: The 5-minute ATR of $0.02 is extremely compressed relative to the $6.43 price, making it nearly impossible to define a meaningful risk/reward structure — any stop tight enough to be logical is within the noise, and any wider stop produces an unfavorable ratio. The last five candles show a low-volume, flat consolidation hugging the 9-EMA with no directional resolution; there is no breakout or breakdown signal to act on. With no news context and an ambiguous post-gap structure (gapped up, sold off to $6.01, recovered to mid-range), the setup lacks the mechanical edge required to commit capital.
